patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring a large, fixed-position brand logo on the right side that visually overlaps the main content area.
A large, fixed-position brand logo on the right side of the hero section scales down and repositions to become a sticky element in the top-left header upon scroll.
A secondary navigation bar (Latest, Shop, Subscribe, Search) becomes sticky at the bottom of the viewport after initial scroll, providing persistent access to key sections.
High-contrast black and white base palette is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with a single vibrant accent color reserved for interactive elements like buttons and links.
Article content is presented with full-bleed imagery, often with minimal text overlay or adjacent to the image, creating a magazine-like visual experience.
Article detail pages feature a main content column alongside a 'Discover more' sidebar on the right, providing related content suggestions.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate a complex header transformation: a large, initially fixed brand logo scales down and animates its position to become a compact, sticky element in the top-left corner of the viewport as the user scrolls. Simultaneously, a bottom navigation bar also becomes sticky.
Content sections are presented with full-bleed imagery, often with text overlaid directly on the image or in a minimal adjacent block, mimicking editorial layouts.
Interactive elements like buttons use a single, strong accent color against a high-contrast black and white background to draw attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, regular weight sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly square elements with minimal to no corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable spacing between article cards and content blocks, with a more expansive feel in the hero section).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a large, fixed-position brand logo that dynamically transforms into a minimalist sticky header on scroll, combined with a persistent bottom navigation, creates a unique, magazine-like browsing experience that prioritizes visual content and a strong brand presence.
